svg.title: Step 2: The hiring person (now versus target)
svg.desc: Step 2 The hiring person. Now: Author is a display-name string; No title, employer or class; Identity rule broken; PRD anti-persona: no recruiter profiling. Target: people record; author_history read method; Authenticity features; Classes, first match wins; Privacy limits. Metric: Classifier agrees with hand labels on ≥ 85% of 100 authors; ≥ 70% of sends go to hiring owners or in-house recruiters.
